exams.name: Company Security Officer Course
exams.blurb: Approved course preparing shoreside personnel to develop and maintain vessel security plans under the ISPS Code and MTSA.

exams.name: Facility Security Officer Course
exams.blurb: Training required for officers responsible for security plans, drills and access control at MTSA-regulated waterfront facilities.

exams.name: Radar Observer (Inland) Certification
exams.blurb: Short course and practical assessment on radar navigation and collision avoidance for inland and river route mariners.

exams.name: Radar Observer (Unlimited) Certification
exams.blurb: Approved course covering radar plotting, relative motion, ARPA principles and collision avoidance for unlimited tonnage service.

exams.name: STCW Advanced Firefighting
exams.blurb: Approved course on shipboard fire command, fixed systems, fire investigation and casualty control required for officer endorsements.

exams.name: STCW Automatic Radar Plotting Aids
exams.blurb: Approved course on ARPA target acquisition, trial manoeuvres, system limitations and errors for officers in charge of a navigational watch.

exams.name: STCW Basic Training
exams.blurb: Four-module STCW course covering personal survival, basic firefighting, elementary first aid and personal safety and social responsibility.

exams.name: STCW Bridge Resource Management
exams.blurb: Approved course on bridge teamwork, situational awareness, communication and error management for watchkeeping deck officers.

exams.name: STCW Electronic Chart Display and Information Systems
exams.blurb: Approved course on electronic chart systems, route planning, alarms, sensor inputs and ECDIS limitations for navigating officers.

exams.name: STCW Leadership and Managerial Skills
exams.blurb: Management-level STCW course on shipboard leadership, resource management, decision making and workload assessment.

exams.name: STCW Leadership and Teamwork
exams.blurb: Operational-level STCW course on teamwork, task allocation and effective communication aboard vessels for junior officers.

exams.name: STCW Medical Care Provider
exams.blurb: Advanced shipboard medical course covering patient assessment, medication administration and radio medical advice for masters and mates.

exams.name: STCW Medical First Aid Provider
exams.blurb: Approved course on immediate care of shipboard casualties including bleeding, burns, fractures, hypothermia and rescue breathing.

exams.name: Vessel Personnel with Designated Security Duties
exams.blurb: STCW security training for crew assigned security tasks, covering threat recognition, screening, search and security equipment use.

exams.name: Vessel Security Officer Course
exams.blurb: Approved course for officers responsible for implementing and maintaining the ship security plan under the ISPS Code.

exams.name: General Radiotelephone Operator License
exams.blurb: Lifetime commercial licence earned by passing Elements 1 and 3, required to repair and maintain most ship and aircraft radio transmitters.

exams.name: GMDSS Radio Maintainer's License
exams.blurb: Licence earned through Elements 1, 3 and 9 authorising at-sea maintenance and repair of Global Maritime Distress and Safety System equipment.

exams.name: GMDSS Radio Operator's License
exams.blurb: Licence earned through Elements 1 and 7 authorising operation of GMDSS distress and safety communications equipment at sea.

exams.name: GMDSS Radio Operator/Maintainer License
exams.blurb: Combined licence covering both GMDSS operating and maintenance privileges, requiring Elements 1, 3, 7 and 9 to be passed.

exams.name: Marine Radio Operator Permit
exams.blurb: Permit obtained by passing Element 1, required to operate radiotelephone stations aboard many passenger and commercial vessels.

exams.name: Radiotelegraph Operator License
exams.blurb: Commercial licence requiring Elements 1, 5 and 6 plus Morse code proficiency for operating and maintaining radiotelegraph stations.

exams.name: Restricted GMDSS Radio Operator License
exams.blurb: Licence earned through Elements 1 and 7R for GMDSS operation on vessels trading only within VHF coverage of coast stations.

exams.name: Restricted Radiotelephone Operator Permit
exams.blurb: Lifetime permit issued without examination, commonly required by pilots flying internationally and by operators of certain radio stations.

exams.name: Restricted Radiotelephone Operator Permit Limited Use
exams.blurb: Permit variant issued to aircraft pilots and other operators who do not qualify for the standard restricted permit.

exams.name: Ship Radar Endorsement
exams.blurb: Endorsement added to a GROL or radiotelegraph licence by passing Element 8, required to service shipboard radar systems.

exams.name: Six Months Service Endorsement
exams.blurb: Endorsement documenting six months of shipboard radio service, needed for certain sole radio operator positions at sea.

exams.name: Aviation Maintenance Technician Airframe Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question FAA written test on airframe structures, systems and inspection required for the airframe rating of a mechanic certificate.

exams.name: Aviation Maintenance Technician General Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question FAA written test covering basic electricity, weight and balance, materials, maintenance forms and regulations shared by all mechanics.

exams.name: Aviation Maintenance Technician Powerplant Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question FAA written test on reciprocating and turbine engines, propellers, fuel and ignition systems for the powerplant rating.

exams.name: FAA Repairman Certificate (Experimental Aircraft Builder)
exams.blurb: Certificate allowing the primary builder of an amateur-built aircraft to perform the annual condition inspection on that specific airplane.

exams.name: FAA Repairman Certificate (Light-Sport Aircraft Inspection Rating)
exams.blurb: Short-course credential permitting owners of special light-sport aircraft to carry out the required annual condition inspection.

exams.name: FAA Repairman Certificate (Light-Sport Aircraft Maintenance Rating)
exams.blurb: Credential earned through an approved 80 to 120 hour course authorising maintenance and inspection of light-sport aircraft by class.

exams.name: Inspection Authorization Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test for experienced A&P mechanics seeking Inspection Authorization to approve major repairs and perform annual inspections.

exams.name: Parachute Rigger Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: FAA written test covering parachute construction, packing, maintenance and record keeping for senior and master parachute rigger certificates.

exams.name: Parachute Rigger Military Competence Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: Abbreviated 25-question test for military-trained riggers converting service experience into an FAA parachute rigger certificate.

exams.name: American Sailing 101 Basic Keelboat Sailing
exams.blurb: Entry sailing certification covering points of sail, tacking, gybing, rules of the road and crew overboard recovery on small keelboats.

exams.name: American Sailing 103 Basic Coastal Cruising
exams.blurb: Certification for skippering an auxiliary-powered sailboat of about 25 to 35 feet in moderate coastal conditions by day.

exams.name: American Sailing 104 Bareboat Cruising
exams.blurb: Certification for chartering and skippering a 30 to 45 foot cruising sailboat, including provisioning, anchoring and systems management.
